arabic_text: وَجَرَى في ظُلْمِهِ وَجَوْرِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَلَى أشْياعِكُمْ ،
transliteration: wa jarā fī ẓulmihi wa jawrihi ʿalaykum wa ʿalā ash-yāʿikum
english_text: boldly gave currency to reign of terror and cruelty to oppress you and your friends and followers;

arabic_text: بَرِئْتُ إلى اللهِ وَإلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُمْ ، وَأتَقَرَّبُّ إلى اللهِ وَإلى رَسولِهِ ثُمَّ إلَيْكُمْ بِمُوالاتِكُم وَمُوالاةِ وَلِيِّكُمْ ، وَبِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْ أعْدائِكُمْ ،وَالنَّاصِبِينَ لَكُم الحَرْبَ ،
transliteration: baritu ila allahi wa-ilaykum minhum wa ʾataqarrabu ʾilā allāhi wa ʾilā rasūlihi thumma ilaykum bimuwalatikum wa muwalat awliyaa'ikum wa bil-barā'ati min aʿdā'ikum, wa al-nāṣibīna lakum al-ḥarb
english_text: I detach myself from them and present myself to Allah and to you, I (first) seek greater intimacy with Allah and then with you to win your love and patronage, and to make friends with your friends, cut off all links with your enemies, and with those who planted the seeds of hostility against you,

arabic_text: وَبِالبَرَاءَةِ مِنْ أشْياعِهِمْ وَأتْباعِهِمْ ،
transliteration: wa bil-barā'ati min ash-yā'iham wa atbā'iham
english_text: and reject and discard their associates, their followers and their friends.

arabic_text: يا أبا عَبدِ الله
transliteration: yā abā ʿabdillāh
english_text: O Abu Abdillah.

arabic_text: إنِّي سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سالَمَكُمْ ، وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حارَبَكُمْ ، وَوَلِيٌّ لِمَنْ والاكُمْ ، وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عاداكُمْ ،
transliteration: 'innī ṣilmun liman sālamakum waḥarbum liman ḥārabakum wa waliyyun liman walaakum waʿaduwwun liman ʿādākum
english_text: I make peace with those who made their peace with you, I search out and confront those who waged war against you, I make friends with those who stood by you, I strive against those who came in conflict with you, therefore,

arabic_text: فَأسْألُ اللهَ الّذِي أكْرَمَني بِمَعْرِفَتِكُمْ ، وَمَعْرِفَةِ أوْلِيائِكُمْ ، وَرَزَقَني البَراءَةَ مِنْ أعْدائِكُمْ ، أنْ يَجْعَلَني مَعَكُمْ في الدُّنْيا وَالآخِرَةِ ، وَأنْ يُثَبِّتَ لي عِنْدَكُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْق في الدُّنْيا وَالآخِرَةِ ،
transliteration: fa-as'alullah alladhi akramani bi-ma'rifatikum, wa ma'rifati awliya'ikum wa razaqani al-bara'ata min a'da'ikum an yajʿalani maʿakum fi ad-dunya wal-akhirah wa-an yuthabbita li ʿindakum qadamu sidqin fi al-dunya wa al-akhirah
english_text: I make a request to Allah to acquaint (me) with the awareness that perceives you and your friends, to set me free from the corrupting influence of your enemies, to make me keep company with you in this would and in the Hereafter, stand firm beside you and follow your footsteps closely in this world and in the next world.

arabic_text: وَأسْألُهُ أنْ يُبَلِّغَنِي الْمقامَ الْمَحْمُودَ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللهِ ، وَأنْ يَرْزُقَنِي طَلَبَ ثَارِي مَعَ إمَام مَهْدِيٍّ ظَاهِر نَاطِق بالحقِّ مِنْكُمْ ،
transliteration: wa as'aluhu an yuballighani al-maqam al-mahmud lakhum 'inda allah wa-an yarzuqanī ṭalaba ṯārī maʿa imām maḥdī naẓīr ʾbil-ḥaqq min-kum
english_text: I beseech Him that he helps me to reach your highly praised station, given to you by Allah, (to meet you), He provides me the opportunity to fight for justice and fairplay alongwith and under the leadership of the rightly guided guide (in your progeny) who surely will come and speak the truth.

arabic_text: وَأسْألُ اللهَ بِحَقِّكُمْ وَبِالشَّأنِ الَّذِي لَكُمْ عِنْدَهُ أنْ يُعْطِيَنِي بِمُصابِي بِكُمْ أفْضَلَ ما يُعْطِي مصاباً بِمُصِيبَتِهِ ، يا لَها منْ مُصِيبَة مَا أعْظَمَها وَأعْظَمَ رَزِيّتهَا فِي الإسلام وَفِي جَمِيعِ أهلِ السَّموَاتِ وَالارْضِ .
transliteration: wa as'alullaha bihaqqikum wa bilsha'ni alladhi lakum 'indahu 'an yu'tiya nī bimuṣābī bikum afḍala mā yu'tī muṣīban bimuṣībatihī yā lahā min muṣībatin mā aʿẓamahā wa aʿẓama razīyatuhā fī al-islām wa fī jamiʿi ahli as-samāwāti wal-ardh
english_text: I beseech Allah in the name of your right and the purpose He assigned to you, that He overwhelms me with grief in memory of your sorrows, more than the personal grief that torments any one who is in great agony, sorrows which have no parallel and overshadow all calamities that took place in the history of Islam, for that matter, through out the whole universe.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْني في مَقامِي هذا مِمَّن تَنالُهُ مِنْكَ صَلَواتٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ .
transliteration: allahumma ij'alni fi maqami hatha mimman tanaluho minka ṣalawātun wa raḥmatun wa maghfiratun
english_text: O my Allah, in my on the spot situation, treat me like him (or her) who obtains from You (Your) blessings, mercy and forgiveness.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَحْيايَ مَحْيا مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد ، وَمَماتي مَماتَ مُحَمَّد وَآل مُحَمَّد .
transliteration: allāhumma ajʿal mahyāya mahya muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa mamātī mamāta muḥammad wa āl muḥammad
english_text: O my Allah, bring me to life again, after death, in the place Mohammad and his "Aal" (children) are dwelling, make me depart from this world like Mohammad and his "Aal" (children) had left,

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ إنَّ هَذا يَوْمٌ تَبَرَّكَتْ بِهِ بَنُو اُمَيَّةَ وَابْنُ آكِلَةِ الاكْبادِ ، اللعِينُ بْنُ اللعِينِ عَلَى لِسانِكَ وَلِسانِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ في كُلِّ مَوْطِن وَمَوْقِف وَقَفَ فِيهِ نَبيُّكَ - صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ - .
transliteration: allāhumma innahā yawmun tabarrakat bihi banū umayyah wa ibn ʾākilatil akbād al-laʿīnu bn al-laʿīni ʿalā lisānik wa lisāni nabiyyika ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa ālihi fī kulli mawṭin wa-mawqif waqafa fīhi nabiyyuka - ṣallā allāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālih -
english_text: O my Allah this day is a day of rejoicing for the "Bani Umayyah", the herd of hardened criminals, the eternally damned and accursed group, a fact that had been made public by You and by Your Prophet (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), who, in every place and at all occasions, drew attention of people to this truism.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ الْعَنْ أبَا سُفْيانَ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ وَيَزيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ وآلَ مَرْوَانَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْكَ اللعْنَةُ أبَدَ الآبِدِينَ ،
transliteration: allāhumma l-ʿan abā sufyāna wa muʿāwiyah wa yazīd ibn muʿāwiyah wa āla marwān, ʿalayhim minka al-laʿnatu abadan al-ābidīn
english_text: O my Allah condemn and damn Abu Sufyaan, and Muawa'awiyah, son of Muwa'awiyah and let it be an everlasting curse upon tem from You.

arabic_text: وَهذا يَوْمٌ فَرِحَتْ بِهِ آلُ زِيَاد وَآلُ مَرْوانَ عَليهِمُ اللَّعْنةُ بِقَتْلِهِمُ الحُسَيْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلام ،
transliteration: wa-haḏā yawmun fariḥat bihi ālu ziyād wa-ālu marwān ʿalayhimu al-laʿnatu bi-qatlihimu al-ḥusayn ʿalayhi al-salām
english_text: Today the descendants of Ziyaad and Marwan make merry, may they be cursed because they had killed al-Husayn (blessings of Allah be on him).

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ فَضاعِفْ عَلَيْهِمُ اللعْنَ وَالعَذابَ الأليم .
transliteration: allāhumma faḍāʿif ʿalayhimu al-laʿna wa al-ʿadhāba al-alīm
english_text: O my Allah, therefore, double up the curse You brings upon them and also the punishment You decrees for them.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ إنِّي أتَقَرَّبُّ إلَيْكَ في هذَا اليَوْمِ ، وَفِي مَوْقِفِي هَذا ، وَأيَّامِ حَيَاتِي بِالبَرَاءَةِ مِنْهُمْ، وَاللعْنَةِ عَلَيْهِمْ ، وَبِالْمُوالاةِ لِنَبِيِّكَ وَآلِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيِه وعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلام.
transliteration: allāhumma innī ataqarrabu ilayka fī hādha al-yawm wa fī mauqifī hadhā, wa ayyāmī ḥayātī bil-barāʾati minhum, wal-laʿnatu ʿalayhim wa bil-muwalāt li-nabiyyika wa āli nabiyyika ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhimus-salām
english_text: O my Allah, I seek nearness to You today in this frame of mind, cutting off all links with them for the rest of my life, denouncing them because of my love for Your Prophet and his children, peace be on him and them.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ الْعَنْ أوّلَ ظالِم ظَلَمَ حَقَّ مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد ، وَآخِرَ تَابِع لَهُ عَلَى ذلِكَ ،
transliteration: allāhumma alʿan awala ẓālim ẓalama ḥaqq muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa ākhir tābiʿ lahu ʿalā dhālika
english_text: O my Allah condemn and damn the first tyrant who unjustly and wrongfully usurped that which rightly belonged to Mohammad and the children of Mohammad, and bring curse upon those who, after him, followed in his footsteps.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ الْعَنِ العِصابَةَ الَّتِي جاهَدَتِ الْحُسَيْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلام وَشايَعَتْ وَبايَعَتْ وَتابَعَتْ عَلَى قَتْلِهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma al-ʿani al-ʿiṣābata allatī jāhadatil-ḥusayna ʿalayhis-salām wa shāyaʿat wa bāyaʿat wa tābaʿat ʿalā qatlih
english_text: O my Allah condemn and damn those conspirators who vexed and harassed Husayn, eagerness, agreed mutually, and joined hands to kill him.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ الْعَنْهم جَميعاً
transliteration: allahumma al'anhum jami'an
english_text: O my Allah bring curse upon all of them.

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا أبا عَبْدِ اللهِ وَعلَى الأرواحِ الّتي حَلّتْ بِفِنائِكَ ،
transliteration: al-salām ʿalayka yā abā ʿabd allāh wa ʿalā al-arwāḥi al-latī ḥallat bifināʾika
english_text: Peace be on you, O Abu Abdullah, and on those souls who came to your camp to put themselves at your disposal.

arabic_text: وَأنَاخَت برَحْلِك عَلَيْكَ مِنِّي سَلامُ اللهِ أبَداً مَا بَقِيتُ وَبَقِيَ الليْلُ وَالنَّهارُ ، وَلا جَعَلَهُ اللهُ آخِرَ العَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمْ ،
transliteration: wa ana-khatab raḥlika ʿalayka minnī salāmu allāh abadan ma baqītu wa baqiya al-laylu wa al-nahār wa lā jaʿalahu allāhu ākhira al-ʿahdi minnī li-ziyāratikum
english_text: So far I am alive and the days and nights follow each other I invoke Allah to send blessings on you for ever and ever. May Allah not make my this pledge of close association, physical as well as spiritual, with you the last fulfillment.

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَى الحُسَيْن ، وَعَلَى عَليِّ بْنِ الحُسَيْنِ ، وَعَلَى أوْلادِ الحُسَيْنِ ، وَعَلَى أصْحابِ الحُسَينِ الذينَ بَذَلُوا مُهَجَهُم دُونَ الحُسين
transliteration: al-salām ʿalá al-ḥusayn wa ʿalā ʿaliyy ibn al-ḥusayn, wa ʿalā awlād al-ḥusayn wa ʿalā aṣḥābi al-ḥusayn alladhīna baḏalu muhajahum dūna al-ḥusayn
english_text: Peace be on Husayn, and on Ali son of Husayn, and on the children of Husayn, and on the friends of Husayn.

arabic_text: اللهمَّ خُصَّ أنْتَ أوّلَ ظالم بِاللّعْنِ مِنِّي ،
transliteration: allāhumma khuṣṣa anta awwala ẓālimin bil-laʿni minnī
english_text: O my Allah, let the curse I call down on the head of the first tyrant stick like a leech;

arabic_text: وَابْدَأْ بِهِ أوّلاً ، ثُمَّ الثَّانِي ، وَالثَّالِثَ وَالرَّابِع ، اللهُمَّ الْعَنْ يزِيَدَ خامِساً ، وَالْعَنْ عُبَيْدَ اللهِ بْنَ زِيَاد وَابْنَ مَرْجانَةَ وَعُمَرَ بْنَ سَعْد وَشِمْراً
transliteration: wa-ibda' bihi aw-walan, thumma ath-thani wa al-thalitha wa al-rabia, allahumma al'an yazid khamsan walʿan ʿubayd allāh ibn ziyād wa ibn marjānah waʿumar ibn saʿd wa shimran
english_text: and stay put for ever on the first, then the second, the third and the fourth. O my Allah damn and call down evil on the fifth, Yazid son of Mua'awyah, and bring a curse upon Ubaydullah son of Ziyaad, ibna Marjanah, Umar son of Saad, and Shimr,

arabic_text: وَآلَ أبي سُفْيانَ وَآلَ زِيَاد وآلَ مَرْوانَ إلَى يَوْمِ القِيامَةِ.
transliteration: wa āla abī sufyan wa āla ziyād wa āla marwāna ilā yawm al-qiyāmah
english_text: on the descendants of Abu Sufyaan, on the descendants of Ziyaad, on the descendants of Marwaan, till the Day of judgement.

arabic_text: اللهمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ حَمْدَ الشَّاكِرينَ لَكَ عَلَى مُصابِهِمْ ،
transliteration: allāhumma laka al-ḥamdu ḥamda al-shākirīna laka ʿalā muṣābihim
english_text: O my Allah! (All) praise is for You (alone); praise of the "Ever-thankful to You", who glorify You whatever come to pass.

arabic_text: الحَمْدُ للهِ عَلَى عَظِيمِ رَزِيّتي.
transliteration: al-ḥamdu li-llāh ʿalā ʿaẓīmi raziyyatī
english_text: (All) praise is for Allah for my deep-felt intense grief.

arabic_text: اللهُمَّ ارْزُقْني شَفاعَةَ الحُسَيْن عَلَيهِ السَّلام يَوْمَ الوُرُودِ ، وَثَبِّتْ لي قَدَمَ صِدْق عِنْدَكَ مَعَ الحُسَيْنِ وَأصْحابِ الحُسَيْن الّذِينَ بَذَلُوا مُهَجَهُمْ دُونَ الْحُسَيْن عَلَيْهِ السَّلام.
transliteration: allāhumma arzuq-nī shafāʿata al-ḥusayn ʿalayhi as-salām yawma al-wurūd wa thabbit li qadam sadqi `indaka ma`a al-husayn wa-aṣḥābi al-ḥusayn alladhīna baḏalū muhajahum dūna al-ḥusayn ʿalayhi as-salām
english_text: O my Allah make available for me the recommendations of Husayn on the day I present myself before You, let me stand firm in safety before You on account of my sincere attachment with Husayn, alongwith him and his comrades, who sacrificed everything they had (heart, mind, soul and life) for Husayn, peace be on him.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ حَقَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآخِرَ تَابِعٍ لَهُ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma al'ana ʾawwala żālimin. ẓalama ḥaqq muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin. wa akhira tabi'in lahu 'ala dhalika.
english_text: O Allah, pour curses upon the foremost persecutor who usurped the right of Muhammad and Muhammad’s Household and the last follower who acceded to his deed.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنِ ٱلْعِصَابَةَ ٱلَّتِي جَاهَدَتِ ٱلْحُسَيْنَ وَشَايَعَتْ وَبَايَعَتْ وَتَابَعَتْ عَلَىٰ قَتْلِهِ
transliteration: allāhumma al'anil ʿiṣābata allatī jāhadata al-ḥusayn. wa shāyaʿat wabāyaʿat watabaʿat ʿalá qatlihi
english_text: O Allah, pour curses upon the gang that struggled against al-Husayn and who supported each other against him, paid homage to his enemies, and participated in slaying him.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْهُمْ جَمِيعاً
transliteration: Allāhumma al-ʿanhum jameeʿan.
english_text: O Allah, pour curses upon all of them.
